away.summary: The Blue Jackets (4-5-0) are 3-2 in their last five games, including a 2-1 overtime win over Vegas on Saturday. Cam Talbot is projected to start in net after stopping 26 of 27 shots versus the Golden Knights. Dante Fabbro has been activated off injured reserve and is a game-time decision for his season debut, while Ivan Provorov and Isac Lundestrom remain out with lower-body injuries.

out.detail: upper body injury; placed on IR retroactive to Oct. 24, expected to miss at least two weeks

home.summary: The Flyers (3-7-3) have lost two straight, including a 5-4 home defeat to Anaheim on Saturday. With a back-to-back (Tuesday vs. Columbus, Wednesday in Washington), Dan Vladar is projected to start in net while Joseph Woll handles the second game. Cam York has been activated off injured reserve and will play after missing eight games with an upper-body injury; Rasmus Ristolainen was placed on IR after reaggravating his upper-body injury versus the Ducks.
